comments.body:
Tracking in openSUSE Bugzilla as https://bugzilla.opensuse.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1289089

Failed openQA job: https://openqa.opensuse.org/tests/6312586

Claude Sonnet 5.5 analysis:

Cause: the golang.org/x/sys bump from v0.47.0 to v0.49.0 in v1.46.0. It adds a hand-written ppc64x assembly trampoline that breaks under PIE builds. This is my diagnosis from reading the code and register dump, and I haven't reproduced it on ppc64le.

  What changed
  - v1.46.0 vendors a new file, vendor/golang.org/x/sys/unix/asm_linux_ppc64x.s. v1.45.x didn't have it.
  - It defines unix.Syscall, Syscall6, RawSyscall and RawSyscall6 as tiny stubs:
  MOVD $syscall·Syscall6(SB), R31
  MOVD R31, CTR
  JMP  (CTR)
  - The stubs jump into the syscall package through CTR.

  Why it crashes
  - On ppc64le, calling a function in another package through CTR requires R12 to hold the callee's entry address. The callee's global entry point derives its TOC pointer (R2) from R12.
  - These stubs set R31 and CTR but never R12. In your dump r12 = 0xeb, which is leftover garbage, and r2 = 0x202af7b, which isn't a valid TOC address (the binary is mapped around 0x135…).
  - The binary is PIE (the addresses suggest -buildmode=pie, which openSUSE uses). Any TOC-relative load then faults.
  - The first one is in runtime.reentersyscall → traceEnabled, called from syscall.Syscall6. That's fileutils.Exists → unix.Faccessat2 during config.Default(), right at startup in mainInit.
  - The Go version probably isn't the cause. A non-PIE build probably works because it doesn't depend on R2 being rebuilt from R12. Go 1.27 may just expose it.

https://github.com/golang/go/issues/82324 I guess, looks like fedora picked a patched here https://src.fedoraproject.org/rpms/golang-x-sys/blob/rawhide/f/ppc64-syscall-register.patch but since we all use vendored deps this does not really matter and we will need an update of the dep. However I see no new tag golang/x/sys so we would need to bump it to a commit or just wait.

Fix in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/pull/7222
I backport it to the 1.46 branch.
